statement: Build a one-file website for CodeSprint Pune 2027, a two-day student and professional hackathon in Pune, where participants compare tracks, calculate fees, register a team, and see the schedule, prizes, FAQs and sponsors, and mentors can sign up.
audience: Students and professionals in and around Pune who want to join the hackathon as participants, plus mentors who want to volunteer; most will visit on phones.
standards: Energetic and clear look and feel
Works well on phones, with no horizontal scrolling at 360px or 1280px
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
Every form field has a visible label and clear error messages
High-contrast mode covers the whole page
Photos and sponsor logos are clearly marked placeholders
rules: Show every fact exactly as given in the brief; never invent or change one
Early-bird 10% applies to entry fees only, never to meal passes
College name is shown and required only when ticket type is Student
Dietary preference is shown only when meal passes is yes
Use placeholders, not real images, for photos and sponsor logos
done_when: The page shows the name CodeSprint Pune 2027, the venue Lakeside Tech Hall, 12 Lake Road, Pune 411002, and the dates Saturday 6 March 2027 and Sunday 7 March 2027
The page shows the contact details code@example.com and WhatsApp +91 00000 55555
A track comparison shows Web Track, AI Track and Hardware Track with team size, build time and first prize for each
The page shows entry fees (Student Rs 400, Professional Rs 800), the optional meal pass at Rs 200 each, and the early-bird 10% off entry fees only up to 15 February 2027
A fee calculator takes ticket type (Student or Professional), number of participants (1 to 4) and number of meal passes, and shows the total with the early-bird discount applied to entry fees only

A registration form has team name, lead name, lead email, lead phone, track dropdown, ticket type, college name (shown and required only for Student), number of participants (1 to 4), meal passes yes/no and dietary preference (Vegetarian or Non-vegetarian, shown only if meal passes is yes), and sends to register@example.com
A separate mentor form has name, email, area of expertise (Web, AI, Hardware) and availability (Saturday, Sunday or both), and sends to mentors@example.com
The schedule lists Day one and Day two with every time and event given in the brief
The prizes section shows the first prize for each of the three tracks
An FAQ section answers all six questions given in the brief
A sponsors section shows Gold, Silver and Community tiers with the named sponsors and logo placeholders, and photo placeholders are present
A countdown to the start of the hackathon on 6 March 2027 is shown and updates live
A menu stays on screen while scrolling and highlights the section currently in view
A high-contrast mode toggle changes the colours of the whole page and can be switched back
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
visitor_needs: Work out what they will pay with a fee calculator
Register their team with a form
See the day-one and day-two schedule
See the prizes for each track
Mentors sign up with a separate form
See a countdown to the start
Find the venue and contact details
facts: Lakeside Tech Hall, 12 Lake Road, Pune 411002
